text.p: These were some of the headlines on Latvian state radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Eu leaders agreed a new treaty at Amsterdam summit.
- Transport Minister Krishtopans survies a no-confidence vote over allegations he broke an anti-corruption law.
- Political parties consider a reaction to Prime Minister Andris Shkele's TV speech, in which he made several strong criticisms, including a charge they act in their own interest.
- The first Latvian has been accepted at the prestigious U.S. West Point military academy.
